messages.subject: An Rattle install update
parts:
Hello Every one,

Graham had me run through a complete install on both XP and Windows 7.

The test results are that I now have Rattle 2.5.46 working on both XP and Win 7, using R 2.12.0 and RGtk 2.20.3 and Gtk 2.20 .

This is as long as zlib.dll is removed from the XML package, and a series of installs are performed.

Graham is waiting to hear from the XML package owner, and should put out the work around soon.

Regards
Tony
